arStrings.szText: "Oracle Cyra, is there a problem with the Sightless Eye?"
Since the Eye was returned, it no longer grants us visions. Its purpose has been altered forever. The loss is bitter, but this is not our end.
CYRA is hopeful the oracles can succeed without the artifact.
You would forsake it entirely? What of my vision?
She is speaking to her boss, so she can't be disrepsectful, but she is passionate.
I’ve seen many threads woven through your fate, and too many fray. I know your visions drive you, but this need not be your undoing.
Kindly and persuasive. CYRA has seen into the future and knows what ATHRPA wants will lead to her ruin. This saddens her.
You have brought the Eye here, so you do not mean to deny me outright.
(sighs) You may try awakening the Eye again. May fate lie in your favor.
